Show text, buttons, and lists inside ECHO.
A plugin is a zip you import into ECHO. It runs in a sandbox and cannot see files, passwords, or the audio stream.
Put echo-plugin.json and main.js at the root of the zip. format and api must both be 1. Unknown manifest fields are ignored.
ECHO calls onLoad, onEnable, onDisable, onPageOpen, onPlayback, and onAction. You only need the ones you use.

Call echo.playback, echo.library.search, echo.storage, echo.net.fetch, echo.ui.setPage, echo.log, and echo.after. Each call returns ok, or an error such as not_granted. Timers cannot be faster than one second.
List the permissions you need. They stay off until the user allows each one on the plugin page.
